greece.title: Flag of Greece

colors.note: Represents the sea, sky, and liberty
Symbolizes purity and the waves of the sea

desc: - Nine horizontal stripes alternating blue and white with a blue canton bearing a white cross
- The nine stripes traditionally represent the syllables of the national motto 'Eleftheria i Thanatos' (Freedom or Death)
trivia:
- The nine horizontal stripes represent the nine syllables of the Greek motto 'Eleftheria i thanatos' (Freedom or Death)
- The blue and white have been Greek colours since the War of Independence from Ottoman rule
- The cross represents the Orthodox Christian faith central to Greek identity
